description: Attestation of a FIAT IN-KIND donation: a real-world infrastructure cost (servers / cloud / domains / bandwidth / hardware) paid directly to a vendor, in fiat, FOR the mission, per ADR-2606111800 §A. No money flows to etzhayyim — the payer bears the fiat cost and the mission receives the resource — so this is identical in form to the in-kind COMPUTE donation (ADR-2606012100) and never touches etzhayyim's money layer or any fiat processor (ADR-2605172100 does not apply). NON-TITHEABLE (no USDC moves; 100% serves the mission). NO quid-pro-quo (earns the payer nothing — anti-class G4). IMPUTED-VALUED for transparency only via toritate valuation tables (ADR-2605262900): AGGREGATE, method-versioned, no per-donor leaderboard. Carries NO receipt/invoice PII — only the period, category, imputed USDC-equivalent value, and the payer DID. This is the record that makes the founder's (and any supporter's) ongoing fiat infrastructure spend a visible, accountable in-kind donation.

payerDid.description: DID of the member/supporter who paid the infrastructure cost in fiat for the mission. The donor; bears the cost arm's-length, receives nothing in return (G4).

period.description: Reporting period this cost covers, e.g. 2026-Q2 or 2026-06. Aggregate over the period; never per-line-item or per-invoice.

category.description: Kind of infrastructure cost paid for the mission.

imputedValueMicros.description: Imputed USDC-equivalent value of the fiat cost in USDC micros (6 decimals; 1 USDC = 1000000), computed via the published toritate valuation tables (method-versioned, auditable; ADR-2605262900). Transparency only — no USDC actually moves. Integer-with-implied-units per ADR-2605190900 (no float in Lexicons).

fiatCurrency.description: OPTIONAL ISO-4217 code of the fiat actually paid (e.g. JPY, USD), for valuation transparency. The fiat amount itself is NOT published (it can carry vendor/account specifics); only the imputed USDC-equivalent is.

valuationMethodRef.description: OPTIONAL AT URI of the toritate valuation-table version used to impute imputedValueMicros (open-source, method-versioned). Lets a third party reproduce the imputed figure.

titheable.description: MUST be false. In-kind: no USDC moves, so there is nothing to split 90/10 (kisha precedent, ADR-2605192130 §5); 100% of the resource serves the mission directly.

compensatedUsdMicros.description: MUST be 0. An uncompensated gift; etzhayyim pays the donor nothing (paying the donor would make this a commercial cost, not a donation).

grantsBenefit.description: MUST be false. Donating infrastructure earns the donor no perk, tier, priority, or benefit (anti-class G4; ADR-2606012100).
